article.headline: Green Bay defeats UMKC 77-72
article.description: — Isaiah Sutherland’s 21 points helped Green Bay defeat UMKC 77-72 on Tuesday.

categories.description: Green Bay Phoenix @ Kansas City Roos

event.description: Green Bay Phoenix @ Kansas City Roos

keywords: Green Bay Phoenix @ Kansas City Roos
article.story: KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- — Isaiah Sutherland’s 21 points helped Green Bay defeat UMKC 77-72 on Tuesday. Sutherland shot 6 for 10 (5 for 8 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Phoenix (4-4). Orlando Lovejoy scored 18 points and added five assists. Ahmere Carson shot 5 for 12 (1 for 5 from 3-point range) and 5 of 9 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points, while adding six rebounds and five steals. Assane Diop led the Roos (3-5) in scoring, finishing with 14 points and two blocks. UMKC also got 14 points and three steals from Jaylen Smith. Lincoln Goodwin finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
